look: Session board on a dot-grid desk: a folder tree wired to a database tile, a manifest card drifted from its SQL files, a file path becoming an entity name, a new file popping into the tree, an assistant tile dropping SQL into its one slot, and the dbd end card. Plain. Colors and type from the Zen-Sumi design system: washi paper, sumi ink, rationed vermillion for what is wrong, jade for what is right.
